data.title: Data Export
data.hint: Download your data for backup or analysis.

export.title: Export Transactions
export.hint: Download all transactions as a CSV file. Optionally filter by date range.
export.formatComma: Amounts are written like -12,50, with semicolons between columns, following your number format in <preferences>Preferences</preferences>. Report exports use the same separator.
export.formatDot: Amounts are written like -12.50, with commas between columns, following your number format in <preferences>Preferences</preferences>. Report exports use the same separator.

backup.title: Full Backup
backup.hint: Download a complete JSON backup of all your data — accounts, transactions, budgets, categories, payees, rules, recurring transactions, goals, reports and dashboards. Bank connection credentials are not included.

restore.title: Restore from Backup
restore.hint: Replace all of your data with a backup file. A copy of your current data is saved first.
restore.notBackup: {{name}} is not a FlyBudget backup file.
restore.safetyCopy: Your previous data was saved as {{file}} next to the database.
restore.confirmMessage: All of your current data will be replaced with the contents of {{name}}. Bank connections stay connected.

preferences.saved: Settings are saved automatically to your browser.
preferences.savedDemo: Settings are kept in this tab while you try the demo.

icons.categoryHint: Emoji icons next to category names
icons.accountHint: Account logos (or colored initials) next to account names

amounts.title: Amounts
amounts.hint: How amounts are shown and typed on this device. Automatic follows your device's language. You can always type 12.50 or 12,50.
amounts.automaticHint: Automatic writes it as {{currency}} is written at home. Symbols of other currencies are in <currencies>Currencies</currencies>.
amounts.symbolHint: Up to 3 characters (e.g. $, €, EUR, kr). Or choose your budget's currency in <currencies>Currencies</currencies>.

accounts.title: Account Order
accounts.hint: Drag to reorder accounts in the sidebar.
accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Add one from the Accounts page.

connections.title: Connected Banks
connections.hint: Automatically import transactions from your financial institutions.
connections.synced_one: {{provider}} sync complete: {{count, number}} new transaction imported.
connections.synced_other: {{provider}} sync complete: {{count, number}} new transactions imported.
connections.plaidHint: Enter your Plaid API credentials to enable bank connections.
connections.simplefinHint: Enter your SimpleFIN setup token to enable bank connections.
connections.enableBankingHint: European banks (EEA), over PSD2. Free with your own Enable Banking application, for your own accounts.

local.title: Where your data lives
local.demoHint: This demo runs entirely in your browser: nothing you change is sent anywhere or saved. In the app, your budget is a file on your computer or on a server you run.
local.computerHint: Your budget is a file on this computer, and FlyBudget only talks to it through its own local server. Nothing is sent to FlyBudget or anyone else; bank sync contacts Plaid, SimpleFIN or Enable Banking only when you connect a bank.

selfHost.title: Use FlyBudget on your phone and other devices
selfHost.hint: Run FlyBudget on a server you control, such as a home server or a small cloud machine, and sign in from any browser. Your data moves to that server; nobody else hosts it.

offline.title: Offline copy
offline.keep: Keep a copy of my budget on this device
offline.hint: When FlyBudget can't reach its server, it opens with what this browser last loaded. You can look through everything and add new transactions; they're sent when it reconnects. The copy is deleted when you sign out. Turn this off on a shared computer.
offline.waiting_one: {{count, number}} transaction saved on this device is waiting to be sent.
offline.waiting_other: {{count, number}} transactions saved on this device are waiting to be sent.

security.title: Security check
security.allGood: Everything looks good for how you connected just now.
security.warnings_one: {{count, number}} thing to look at. Each is fixed with a setting in your docker-compose.yml.
security.warnings_other: {{count, number}} things to look at. Each is fixed with a setting in your docker-compose.yml.

checks.httpsLocal: Connected on the same computer as the server
checks.httpsMissing: Not using HTTPS: passwords and data travel unencrypted
checks.httpsMissingFix: Put FlyBudget behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS (Caddy, Nginx, Traefik) or a VPN, and set <env>FLYBUDGET_TRUST_PROXY</env>.
checks.trustProxyOk: Reverse proxy settings match how you connect
checks.trustProxyUntrusted: A reverse proxy is in front of FlyBudget, but not trusted
checks.trustProxyUntrustedFix: Set <env>FLYBUDGET_TRUST_PROXY=1</env> (the number of proxies in front of FlyBudget) so HTTPS and client addresses are detected.
checks.trustProxyUnneeded: FLYBUDGET_TRUST_PROXY is set, but this request came without a proxy
checks.trustProxyUnneededFix: If you connect directly, remove <env>FLYBUDGET_TRUST_PROXY</env>: otherwise clients can fake their address and get around the login attempt limit.
checks.allowedHostsOk: Only answers to the addresses you allowed
checks.allowedHostsMissingFix: Set <env>FLYBUDGET_ALLOWED_HOSTS</env> to the address you use, e.g. <env>FLYBUDGET_ALLOWED_HOSTS=budget.example.com</env>.
checks.encryptionKeyOk: Bank credentials are encrypted at rest
checks.encryptionKeyMissingFix: Set <env>FLYBUDGET_DATA_KEY_FILE</env> to a file with a random key (see the self-hosting guide).

devices.title: Signed-in devices
devices.hint: Browsers signed in to this server. Sign out any you don't recognize, then change the password.

password.title: Change password
password.hint: This password protects your FlyBudget server. Changing it signs out every other device.
password.changed: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.

signOut.title: Sign out
signOut.hint: Sign out of FlyBudget on this browser.

currencies.title: Currencies
currencies.hint: Your budget has one currency. Accounts can each have their own: their amounts stay in it, and the budget and reports count them in yours at each day's exchange rate.

budget.title: Budget currency
budget.hint: What your budget, reports and net worth are counted in. It can be corrected while no account in another currency has transactions.
budget.chooseHint: Choose the currency your amounts are in. Nothing is converted: it only names the currency, so accounts in other currencies can be added.

values.title: Values in {{currency}}
values.missing_one: {{count, number}} transaction in {{currencies}} has no exchange rate for its day yet, so the budget counts it as nothing. Add a rate below, or turn on downloading.
values.missing_other: {{count, number}} transactions in {{currencies}} have no exchange rate for their day yet, so the budget counts them as nothing. Add a rate below, or turn on downloading.
values.hint: Every transaction in another currency has its value in {{currency}}. Values stay as they were when a rate changes; recalculate after correcting a rate.

rates.title: Exchange rates
rates.hint: A day without a rate uses the closest earlier one, up to a month back. A rate you type in wins over a downloaded one for its day.
rates.noRecentRate: No rate in the last month
rates.invalid: Type the rate as a positive number, like 1.0812.

download.title: Download rates
download.hint: The European Central Bank's daily reference rates, from {{host}} (Frankfurter, open source). Only currency codes and dates are sent, never anything about your budget. Off until you turn it on; then it checks every few hours.
download.notInDemo: Not available in the demo: rates can be typed in above.
download.unsupported: {{status}}. The ECB has no rates for {{currencies}}: type those in.

display.title: How amounts are written
display.hint: On this device. Automatic writes each currency as at home: 1 234,56 zł, $1,234.56, CHF 1'234.56 (the number format is in Preferences). {{budget}}'s position is the Preferences one.

welcome.title: Welcome to <brand/>!
welcome.intro: A budget that shows where your money goes and gives every dollar a job. Start by adding the accounts you want to track.

plaid.title: Connect with Plaid
plaid.description: Set it up once and new transactions arrive on their own. Create a free Plaid developer account; Plaid then approves access to your real banks.

simplefin.title: Connect with SimpleFIN
simplefin.description: Set it up once and new transactions arrive on their own, through SimpleFIN Bridge (thousands of banks). Paid directly to SimpleFIN.

europe.title: Connect a European bank
europe.description: Set it up once and new transactions arrive on their own, from banks across Europe (PSD2), through your own free Enable Banking application. Log in to your bank again every few months.

manual.title: Add accounts manually
manual.description: You add each account and its balance yourself. Transactions are manual too: download CSV files from your bank and import them yourself, or enter each one by hand. Nothing updates on its own.

welcome.privacyServer: Your budget is stored on your own server. No FlyBudget account, no tracking.
welcome.privacyLocal: Your budget stays on this computer. No FlyBudget account, no tracking.
welcome.skip: Skip for now and look around
